description: The regime of a market, read on its 1 h, 4 h and 5 m candles: strong bull, weak bull, range, weak bear or strong bear with its trend score, the EMA stack, the structure (higher highs and lows), RSI 14 and 6, ATR and whether volatility expands, volume, and how long the regime has held. It tells a trending market from one in a range.

symbol.description: The market, e.g. BTC, ETH, xyz:GOLD

name: perps_regime
title: Market regime
